Mediterranean Quinoa Salad

Served at: Earth Day

Serves 8-10Prep 25 minCook 15 min

This vibrant Mediterranean Quinoa Salad is a perfect dish for an Earth Day potluck, celebrating the bounty of the earth with fresh, wholesome plant-based ingredients. It's hearty enough to be a main dish, yet light and refreshing, making it an ideal contribution to share with friends and family as you honor our planet.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (185g) quinoa, rinsed
  • 2 cups (475ml) vegetable broth or water
  • 1 (15-ounce / 425g) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
  • 1 pint (about 2 cups / 300g) cherry tomatoes, halved
  • 1 large cucumber (about 1.5 cups / 200g), diced
  • 1/2 red onion (about 1/2 cup / 70g), finely diced
  • 1/2 cup (75g) Kalamata olives, pitted and halved
  • 1/4 cup (60ml) fresh lemon juice (from 1-2 lemons)
  • 1/4 cup (60ml) extra virgin olive oil
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 teaspoon dried oregano
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt, or to taste
  • 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, or to taste
  • 1/2 cup (15g) fresh parsley, chopped

Method

  1. Combine rinsed quinoa and vegetable broth (or water) in a medium saucepan.
  2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and quinoa is fluffy.
  3. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and transfer to a large bowl to cool completely.
  4. While quinoa cools, prepare the vegetables: halve cherry tomatoes, dice cucumber, finely dice red onion, and halve Kalamata olives.
  5. Add the cooled quinoa, rinsed and drained chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and Kalamata olives to the large bowl.
  6. In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to create the dressing.
  7. Pour the dressing over the quinoa and vegetable mixture.
  8. Add the fresh chopped parsley to the bowl.
  9. Gently toss all ingredients together until well combined and coated with the dressing.
  10. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt, pepper, or lemon juice to your preference.
  11. Serve immediately or chill for at least 30 minutes for flavors to meld.

Tips

  • This salad can be made up to 2 days in advance; the flavors actually improve over time. Store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
  • For an extra burst of freshness, add 1/4 cup (10g) of fresh chopped mint along with the parsley.
  • If you enjoy a bit of tang, crumbled vegan feta cheese (about 1/2 cup / 60g) makes a wonderful addition to this salad.
